FROM BRIEF TO IMPLEMENTATION

Your project, step by step.

A shared direction at every stage, with clear decisions before moving forward.

  1. 01

    Share your project

    Send floor plans, project location, space requirements, style references, budget and programme.

    STAGE OUTPUTProject brief & scope
  2. 02

    Develop the concept

    Agree the lighting atmosphere, room priorities and the smart functions you want to include.

    STAGE OUTPUTLighting & smart concept
  3. 03

    Review the first proposal

    Review the proposed lighting layout, fixture direction and scene logic together before detailed coordination.

    STAGE OUTPUTInitial layout & proposal
  4. 04

    Refine & coordinate

    Resolve feedback and coordinate fixture details, control compatibility and installation conditions.

    STAGE OUTPUTRevised drawings & selections
  5. 05

    Approve the final package

    Confirm the drawings, product schedule, control scope and quotation before placing an order.

    STAGE OUTPUTApproved design & supply scope
  6. 06

    Supply & technical support

    Coordinate product supply and provide installation guidance and system integration support within the agreed scope.

    STAGE OUTPUTProducts & implementation guidance
